name: Acropolis: doors
_about: The Acropolis: the Parthenon's east door; the Propylaia's five doors in its gate wall (the middle one the processional way); the Pinakotheke's; the Erechtheion's north door, east door and the small door to the Pandroseion -- all wood sheathed in bronze. The Nike temple's front was pillars and bronze grilles, no door
